techniques.evidence: src/features/plugins/companion/DevOpLedger.tsx:89-109 duplicates a backend-defined closed vocabulary in hand-written frontend logic with a silent fallback for unknown values — the same one-authority-per-vocabulary failure already flagged for the action catalog at companion-core-store (d77a22ee, athenaLabels.ts) and commands-companion (3effd422, approval_lifecycle.rs), here applied to the dev-op cycle's outcome vocabulary rather than the action-kind vocabulary.

pairs.registryProposal: The five-copy-vocabulary antipattern this project keeps re-triggering (action kinds in athenaLabels.ts, dev-op status in DevOpLedger.tsx, approval executors in approval_lifecycle.rs) is one structural cause appearing at 3+ independent sites across this project; worth checking whether action-catalog-single-source's guidance should explicitly generalize beyond the action-execution catalog to 'any backend-closed vocabulary a companion surface renders', since this project keeps re-deriving the same defect for vocabularies that aren't literally the action catalog.
